heart.dialog.content(VERSION):
Welcome to Heart v{VERSION}

A Quick Intro

Players: you can make rolls from Chat when requested, or directly from your character sheet. Your GM will provide you with class/callings which you can drag & drop onto your sheet.

GMs: the 'Prepare Rollout Request' macro will help your players make rolls more easily. You'll need to create classes and callings for your players by hand, but it should be more or less intuitive how to do this.

heart.versions.0_5_0.changes.0: Update to work with foundry v10 (thanks to whitespine)
heart.versions.0_6_0.bug_fixes.0: Wigginns - Heretic staff now named staff as intended.
heart.versions.0_6_0.changes.0: Added Resistance types to Mend and Kill Equipment. Now you can mark which stress type a weapon deals or can mend.
heart.versions.0_6_0.changes.1: You can now shift-click an equipment to increase the die by one step when rolling with a critical success or other modifier.
heart.versions.0_6_0.changes.2: Option to display Total Stress on character sheet.
heart.versions.0_6_0.changes.3: Option to display an editable field beside each Resistance that can be edited if you don't like ticking boxes.
heart.versions.0_6_0.changes.4: Added a Tag icon to help distinguish Equipment and Resource tags.
heart.versions.0_6_0.changes.5: Updated the default icon for Landmarks.
heart.versions.0_6_0.notes.0: Existing equipment will not have any Resistances associated with them.
heart.versions.0_7_0.changes.0: Added option to select stress type at the same time as selecting stress size for all stress rolls.
heart.versions.0_7_0.changes.1: Added propeties to delves including Resistance, maxResistance, Domains, Tier, Resources, Equipment, Connections, and notes.
heart.versions.0_7_0.changes.2: Added N/A as default choice for rolling stress from character sheet for the instances where you roll stress from fallout or other non-roll result reasons. This is functionally the same as 'failure'
heart.versions.0_7_0.changes.3: You can now alt-click an equipment roll to decrease the die by one step when rolling with a critical success or other modifier.
heart.versions.0_7_0.notes.0: Updated the listeners on actors to be located on the base actor for less repetition of code
heart.versions.0_8_0.bug_fixes.0: Use await for delete, confirm item group deletions
heart.versions.0_8_0.changes.0: Strikethrough completed beats on calling sheet.
heart.versions.0_8_0.changes.1: Show beat level on character sheet
heart.versions.0_8_0.changes.2: Allow editing beat level on beat sheet
heart.versions.0_8_0.changes.3: Add button to clear stress after suffering fallout
heart.versions.0_8_0.changes.4: Ability to edit Fallout Level and Resistance from Fallout item
heart.versions.0_8_1.notes.0: Thanks to Arcadio21 for providing the italian translations.
heart.versions.0_8_2.bug_fixes.0: Italian transaction fixes, typo correction, translation for objects attributes
heart.versions.0_8_3.bug_fixes.0: Fix warnings about using deprecated "name" instead of "id"
heart.versions.0_8_3.bug_fixes.1: Fix problem with loading compendium entries that have been translated
heart.versions.0_8_3.bug_fixes.2: Fix dragged compendium items not being having their names translated
heart.versions.0_8_3.changes.0: Dragging compendium items will now result in an immediately translated name
heart.versions.0_8_4.bug_fixes.0: Dragging compendium items will no longer accidentally create a duplicate
heart.versions.0_8_5.bug_fixes.0: It is once again possible to open items directly from the compendium
heart.versions.0_8_6.bug_fixes.0: Fixed updates to children of items not triggering a remote re-render
heart.versions.0_8_7.changes.0: Added an option to ignore protection on stress rolls.
heart.versions.0_8_7.changes.1: Users can now click tags and view tag description from preview on character sheet.
heart.versions.0_8_7.changes.2: Buttons on top of sheet size more consistently so you don't end up with one long button.

heart.roll-prompt.difficulty-tip.dangero: Dangerous: remove the two highest dice before reading the result. With no dice left, roll one D10 on the Difficult Actions table.
heart.roll-prompt.difficulty-tip.impossi: Impossible: no roll; the action fails and you take Stress.
heart.roll-prompt.difficulty-tip.risky: Risky: remove the highest die before reading the result. With no dice left, roll one D10 on the Difficult Actions table.
heart.roll-prompt.difficulty-tip.standar: Standard: roll the pool and read the highest die.
heart.roll-prompt.difficulty-why: set by the GM when the stakes are stated
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.battered: Battered: offensive combat actions are Risky.
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.blinded: Blinded: anything that needs sight is Dangerous.
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.broken-ar: Broken Arm: actions with that arm are Risky, Dangerous or impossible.
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.broken-le: Broken Leg: actions that need the leg fail.
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.darkness: Darkness: Delve and Discern actions are Risky.
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.limping: Limping: fast or stealthy movement is Risky.
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.no-ration: No Rations: all actions are Risky.
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.ringing-h: Ringing Head: the next action is Dangerous, then Risky.
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.siren-son: Siren Song: anything but following the song is Risky.
heart.roll-prompt.fallout-hint.spitting-: Spitting Teeth: speaking or looking respectable is Risky.
heart.roll-prompt.gm-override: As GM you can pick anyone.
heart.roll-prompt.helper-full: Two helpers already (the GM can allow more)

heart.roll-prompt.mastery-sources: From a knack that applies, a class ability, Renowned gear or a GM award for good preparation.

heart.rolls.roll.summary-impossible: Impossible: no roll, the action fails

heart.tip.skill.compel: Compel: make people do what you want via threats, lies, flattery, or reasoned argument.
heart.tip.skill.delve: Delve: progress into dangerous or unknown territory.
heart.tip.skill.discern: Discern: understand the world by drawing on accessible information.
heart.tip.skill.endure: Endure: resist the effects of the Heart on your body and mind.
heart.tip.skill.evade: Evade: get away from someone or something that's trying to track you down.
heart.tip.skill.hunt: Hunt: track down someone or something that's trying to get away from you.
heart.tip.skill.kill: Kill: end the lives of people and things, with weapons or your bare hands.
heart.tip.skill.mend: Mend: repair something or someone that is broken, or build something new.
heart.tip.skill.sneak: Sneak: hide yourself or things from the attention of others.
heart.tip.domain.cursed: Cursed: actively harmful locations, places touched by the Heart.
heart.tip.domain.haven: Haven: settlements where people live, work, and form communities.
heart.tip.domain.occult: Occult: hidden knowledge and black magic.
heart.tip.domain.religion: Religion: gods, and things worshipped like gods.
heart.tip.resistance.blood: Blood: physical exhaustion, pain, blood loss, and injury.
heart.tip.resistance.echo: Echo: the twisting of body and mind by the Heart's unreal energies.
heart.tip.resistance.fortune: Fortune: bad luck, incompetence, and overconfidence.
heart.tip.resistance.bond: Bond: Fallout that lands on a bond, a hireling, or an animal, not on you.
heart.tip.resistance.supplies: Supplies: loss of resources, damaged equipment, and debt.
heart.tip.resistance.provisions: Provisions: the whole party's food, water, light, and medicine, on one shared track. Its Fallout befalls every delver.
heart.tip.beats-limit: Two beats are active at a time, and you can hit only one per situation.
heart.tip.beat.pursue: Pursue: you choose your two active beats at the end of each session.
heart.tip.beat.finish: Finish: hitting a beat earns an advance of its level; each beat counts only once.
heart.tip.equipment.kill: Kill: roll this die to inflict Stress on an adversary; without a weapon, it is D4.
heart.tip.equipment.delve: Delve: roll this die to inflict Stress on a delve; without such gear, it is D4.
heart.tip.equipment.mend: Mend: roll this die to remove Stress.
heart.tip.equipment.miscellaneous: Miscellaneous: usually a story effect rather than a Stress die.
heart.tip.haunt.service: Pay a resource to remove its rolled value in Stress here, up to this die size.
heart.tip.haunt.track: Upgrade track: mark it each use; paying the full price without removing Stress marks three.
heart.tip.haunt.upgrade: Upgrade: at six marks, clear them and step up the haunt's dice, from the next visit.
heart.tip.haunt.downgrade: Downgrade: step the haunt's dice down; a D4 haunt that is downgraded is gone.
heart.tip.adversary.difficulty: Difficulty: Standard rolls as normal, Risky removes the highest die, and Dangerous the two highest.
heart.tip.adversary.resistance: Resistance: Stress inflicted on it comes off this; at 0, it is at your mercy.
heart.tip.adversary.protection: Protection: subtract it from all incoming Stress.
heart.tip.delve.resistance: Resistance: a success or partial success inflicts Stress on it, D4 by default; at 0, the journey is complete.
heart.tip.landmark.stress: Default Stress: the standard Stress a delver here takes on a failure or partial success.
heart.tip.party.upkeep: Upkeep: D4 Stress to Provisions, less the quartermaster's Protection.
heart.tip.party.use: Use Provisions: mark Stress here instead of Supplies when the whole party pays the price.
heart.tip.party.volunteer: Become the quartermaster: your Supplies Protection protects Provisions. You can resign it later.
heart.tip.party.resign: Stop being the quartermaster: Provisions has no Protection until someone volunteers or the GM picks one.
heart.tip.party.restock: Restock: mark D4, D6, or D8 to your own Supplies to remove one die size larger from Provisions. Ending a Provisions Fallout is a separate payment: D6 for a Minor, D8 for a Major.
heart.tip.party.scavenge: Scavenge: roll Delve+Domain; a success or a success at a cost removes D4, and a failure finds nothing.
heart.tip.party.relieve: Relieve: only restocking, scavenging, Supplies haunts, sold resources, and Mend Supplies equipment remove Provisions Stress.
heart.tip.party.clear: Clear: a Provisions Fallout of any severity clears the track, and so do a few days in Derelictus.
heart.tip.ignore-protection: Ignore Protection: mark the full roll, as when Piercing or a Fallout such as Shattered turns Protection off.
heart.tip.stakes.passive: Passive: rolling only to avoid harm; on a 6-7, the Stress is one die size lower.
heart.tip.stakes.d4: D4: the lowest Stress, and the usual die on Tiers 0 and 1.
heart.tip.stakes.d6: D6: the usual die on Tiers 2 and 3.
heart.tip.stakes.d8: D8: the usual die on Tier 4.
heart.tip.stakes.d12: D12: the highest Stress a situation can inflict.
heart.tip.card.take-stress: Mark this Stress on the roller and every helper, less each one's Protection.
heart.tip.card.roll-stress: Roll the Stress die the GM names; the roller and every helper mark it, less their own Protection.
heart.tip.card.party-fallout: Provisions Fallout: a D12 against Provisions alone, and it befalls every delver. From 13 Stress, every check is Fallout and Major is Critical.
heart.tip.card.clear-provisions: A Provisions Fallout of any severity clears the track.
heart.tip.tag-uses: Limited X: the uses before it gives out; -1 is unlimited.
heart.term.stress: Stress: marked to a resistance on a failure or a success at a cost. Each time, the GM checks for Fallout.
heart.term.protection: Protection: reduce Stress taken by this much; if none gets through, there is no Fallout roll.
heart.term.fallout: Fallout: each time you mark Stress, the GM rolls a D12; equal to or under your total Stress is Minor (1-6) or Major (7-12).
heart.term.minor-fallout: Minor Fallout: clear all Stress in its resistance. Two Minors can combine into a Major.
heart.term.major-fallout: Major Fallout: clear all Stress in every resistance. Two Majors can combine into a Critical.
heart.term.critical-fallout: Critical Fallout: the end of the character, by death, madness, or another ignoble end.
heart.term.mastery: Mastery: one extra D10, only once per roll however many sources you have.
heart.term.knack: Knack: a Skill or Domain gained a second time, narrowed to one facet; when it applies, roll with Mastery.
heart.term.skill: Skill: what you do; having the Skill that fits adds a D10.
heart.term.domain: Domain: an area of the Heart, knowledge, or connections; having the Domain that fits adds a D10.
heart.term.resistance: Resistance: a delver's Stress track (Blood, Mind, Echo, Fortune, or Supplies); on an adversary or delve, the Stress it takes to finish it.
heart.term.roll: Skill+Domain: roll a D10, plus one for the Skill and one for the Domain if you have them, and read the highest.
heart.term.dangerous: Dangerous: as a difficulty, remove the two highest dice. As a tag, the item's maximum roll marks D6 Stress to Blood.
heart.term.tag.awkward: Awkward: the resource is heavy or hard to carry.
heart.term.tag.beacon: Beacon: the resource attracts something dangerous towards its position.
heart.term.tag.bloodbound: Bloodbound: mark D4 Stress to Blood to roll with Mastery using this for the rest of the situation.
heart.term.tag.brutal: Brutal: when you roll Stress against an adversary with this, roll two dice and keep the highest; each extra Brutal adds a die.
heart.term.tag.conduit: Conduit: mark D4 Stress to Mind to roll with Mastery using this for the rest of the situation.
heart.term.tag.dangerous: Dangerous: when this item's die rolls its maximum, mark D6 Stress to Blood.
heart.term.tag.debilitating: Debilitating: once per situation, after you inflict Stress with this, the next attack against those targets rolls with Mastery.
heart.term.tag.degenerating: Degenerating: if it hurt you, roll Endure+Domain at the end of the situation; a failure marks D6 Stress, a partial success D4.
heart.term.tag.deteriorating: Deteriorating: the resource is breaking down; get it to a new owner quickly.
heart.term.tag.distressing: Distressing: when this item's die rolls its maximum, mark D6 Stress to Mind.
heart.term.tag.double_barreled: Double-Barreled: as Reload, but it can be used twice before reloading.
heart.term.tag.expensive: Expensive: when this item's die rolls its maximum, mark D6 Stress to Supplies.
heart.term.tag.extreme_range: Extreme Range: it can be used at extreme range.
heart.term.tag.fragile: Fragile: the resource is destroyed if dropped or damaged.
heart.term.tag.harmful: Harmful: the resource can harm whoever carries it, by black magic, illness, or strange energies.
heart.term.tag.limited: Limited X: it can be used X times before it gives out.
heart.term.tag.loud: Loud: when this item's die rolls its maximum, mark D6 Stress to Fortune.
heart.term.tag.mobile: Mobile: left unattended, the resource leaves of its own accord.
heart.term.tag.niche: Niche: the resource is only valuable to a very select group of people.
heart.term.tag.obscuring: Obscuring: the bearer and nearby allies reduce incoming and outgoing ranged damage by one step.
heart.term.tag.one_shot: One-Shot: it can only be used once per situation.
heart.term.tag.piercing: Piercing: Blood Protection cannot reduce its Stress, and adversaries get no Protection against it.
heart.term.tag.point_blank: Point-Blank: as Ranged; at very close range its Stress die steps up, and far enough to spread out, it steps down.
heart.term.tag.potent: Potent: when you roll Stress removed with this, roll two dice and keep the highest; it stacks like Brutal.
heart.term.tag.ranged: Ranged: it can be used at range.
heart.term.tag.rare: Rare: finding a trader can take a Discern+Haven roll; every Excellent item is rare.
heart.term.tag.reload: Reload: it must be reloaded between uses, giving enemies a chance to close in or flee.
heart.term.tag.smoke: Smoke: as Obscuring, but only when used, and only around where it was used.
heart.term.tag.spread: Spread: on a success, anyone near the target rolls Evade+Domain to avoid the Stress too; a partial success steps it down.
heart.term.tag.taboo: Taboo: most haunts won't take the resource in barter.
heart.term.tag.tiring: Tiring: when you fail an action with it, its Stress die steps down for the rest of the situation.
heart.term.tag.trusty: Trusty: when you roll Stress against a delve with it, roll two dice and keep the highest; it stacks like Brutal.
heart.term.tag.unreliable: Unreliable: when you fail an action with it, it can't be used for the rest of the situation, or of the journey on a delve.
heart.term.tag.volatile: Volatile: the resource may explode if mistreated.
heart.term.tag.wyrd: Wyrd: when this item's die rolls its maximum, mark D6 Stress to Echo.
heart.trinket.no-table: No table found for {name}. Import the trinket and keepsake tables, or create a table named "{name} Keepsakes" or "{name} Calling Trinkets".
heart.warn.party: Not in a party yet. Drag the party from the Actors sidebar onto this sheet.
heart.warn.no-quartermaster: No quartermaster yet: Provisions has no Protection. A player can volunteer their own character, or the GM picks one on the party sheet.
heart.map.tool.reveal: Reveal (click: hidden, rumoured, known; right-click: back)
heart.map.tool.move: Move landmarks (drag a scrap; double-click opens it). Drop a landmark from the compendium or sidebar to place it.
heart.map.tool.link: Link two landmarks (click one, then the other)
heart.map.tool.erase: Erase: take a landmark off the map, or remove a link
heart.map.tool.preview: Player view (see the map as players do)
heart.map.gm-only: Only the GM can change the Heart map.
heart.map.no-layout: No map layout found: turn on the Heart content module for the map's look and the book landmarks' art. Landmarks can still be dropped on the map.
heart.map.already-linked: Those two landmarks are already linked.
heart.map.placed: {name} is on the map, hidden: reveal it with the Reveal tool.
heart.map.erase-book-link: A book link can't be erased; hide it with Reveal instead.
heart.map.no-delves: No Delve actors in this world yet; a delve link can be tied to one later.
heart.map.remove-lead: Take {name} off the map, with its links? The actor itself is kept.
